about.description: Single-stock perpetual market tracking Tesla, Inc. Users get linear exposure to Tesla share-price moves without owning Tesla shares, shareholder rights, or dividend claims. Pricing follows the market reference used by the km venue on Hyperliquid. Positions are margined and cash-settled in USDH. Markets are visible on Hyperliquid under the km namespace, but are operated by Markets by Kinetiq rather than listed as core Hyperliquid perps.
